topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I can't believe this is happening. I found out someone took the design I spent countless hours on, the one that meant so much to me, and got it tattooed on their skin. They didn't ask, they didn't pay, they just... took it. Now it's permanent, out there in the world, not as something to admire on paper but etched into someone's body. I don't know how to process this. It feels like a violation, like a piece of me is now attached to a stranger, forever. What do I do? How do I even begin to address this?
